cosmetic: The checkboxes in the suggested setup sit on their own line above their labels (e.g. 'Test command', 'Worktree setup command') instead of next to them, so it's less clear which label each checkbox belongs to.
The 'Library' tab at the right end of the Overview tab row touches the panel edge and looks slightly clipped. Any tabs after it may be hidden off-screen, but the visible tabs can still be reached.
Session titles in the sidebar are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Context · Mesh journey fixt...', 'Context · J11 memory journ...'). This looks like intentional truncation.
The status text in the header ('Cache today Unknown · 0 cold starts · 0 tokens written cold', 'Context unavailable') is small monospace text with low contrast, but it can still be read.
